mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0%, it signals severe labor market distress that triggers equity sell-offs due to recessionary fears, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a dual supply-demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO < 95 and HOUST < 550) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher discount rates compress equity valuations, with the effect most pronounced in the first 20 trading days after rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550, it signals weakening consumer demand that reduces retail sector growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST < 550.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing capacity that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals robust economic growth that boosts equity valuations through earnings optimism, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS increases by at least 0.3% month-over-month.
